title: Coaching & gamification
description: Leaderboards, badge rules, QA calibration and agent development plans.
no_organization: Select an organization to use this page.
forbidden: This page needs permission to view schedules or manage quality. Ask your organization admin for access.
error.title: Could not load data
error.description: Refresh the page and try again.
filters.invalid_range: The start cannot be after the end.
metric_hint.resolutions: Earned by resolving at least this many conversations in the window.
metric_hint.frt: Earned when the average first response time is at or below this many seconds (lower is better).
metric_hint.csat: Earned when the average rating (0–5) is at least this value.
metric_hint.qa: Earned when the average manual QA score (0–100) is at least this value.
leaderboard.empty: No agents to rank in this window.
leaderboard.hint: Points are calculated live for the selected window; each badge is earned once per window. The team filter shows current team members. Agents who opted out are not listed.
optout.label: Hide me from the leaderboard
optout.hint: Changes only your own preference; while on, you are not scored or listed.
optout.hidden: You are now hidden from the leaderboard.
optout.visible: You are visible on the leaderboard again.
rules.description: Badges award points to agents who pass a KPI threshold in the selected window.
rules.form_hint: Rules are saved by name; the name cannot be changed later.
rules.name: Badge name
rules.duplicate: A rule with this name already exists; edit it instead.
rules.empty: Add the first badge rule to start the leaderboard.
rules.hint: Rules are switched off, not deleted. Changes also apply to past windows. Up to 100 rules.
calibrations.description: Reviewers score the same resolved conversation blind; variance shows once the session is closed.
calibrations.form_hint: The scorecard's criteria are copied into the session.
calibrations.name: Session name
calibrations.scorecards_error: Could not load scorecards (you need permission to view quality).
calibrations.conversation_hint: Only conversations in the resolved state can be calibrated.
calibrations.empty: Start a session to measure consistency between reviewers.
calibrations.open_hint: Submit your scores; other reviewers' scores stay hidden until the session closes.
calibrations.closed_hint: The session is closed; reviewer results and variance are below.
calibrations.score_hint: Each criterion needs a 0–100 score and a rationale. A 0 on a critical criterion makes the total 0. Each reviewer can score once.
calibrations.submitted: Your scores were saved. Close the session once at least two reviewers have scored.
calibrations.results_hint: Variance is the population variance. Criteria where reviewers are {{spread}} points or more apart are flagged. Calibration scores do not affect the agent's QA KPI.
items.kind_hint.note: A session note; it has no due date or goal.
items.kind_hint.goal: A development goal for the agent; optional due date.
items.kind_hint.task: A follow-up task under a goal; due date required.
items.pick: Select an agent to see their notes, goals and follow-up tasks.
items.truncated: Only the newest {{count}} entries are shown.
